taxonomy.note: Each example demonstrates one impetus mode paired with one coordination structure. Source/target task pairs vary so the example can fit the local Workspace carriers naturally. Revised seed examples emphasize local genre fit, explicit cross-record references, and reduced single-carrier leakage while preserving the existing task/site schema.

The email remains the actionable anchor; the other carriers reinforce legitimacy without repeating a long command verbatim.
